behavioral_findings.label: Execute button onClick → handleExecute
behavioral_findings.evidence: Calls voxTransport.callTool(selectedPath.replace(/ /g,'_'), {...argsObj, __argv:parsedArgs}). Transport resolves via action manifest → mcp (invoke_mcp_tool) or cli path (execute_command). Structured argValues are merged with raw __argv input. Partial: callTool has hardcoded fast-paths only for vox_list_models/vox_set_active_model/vox_explain_model/vox_suggest_model; all other commands fall through to manifest lookup. If manifest lookup misses (action not found, no cli_path, resolvePath fails) transport still tries invoke('execute_command') — may error at runtime. Output panel correctly displays exit_code, stdout, stderr.
